plan_reference: E:/.../Week19立项计划_文献驱动三线.md §W19-3 eta channel cross-model consistency
purpose: Cross-model consistency check of the eta channel: retrain a Chemprop D-MPNN on the frozen row-level viscosity pool under the SAME GroupShuffleSplit-by-InChIKey protocol as the incumbent XGB, and compare MAE on log10(cP).

correction_registered_before_run.clause_2: The state is stale: reports/decisions_log.md 28.38 already unfroze those rows and judged the arm refuted, three pools at MAE 0.17477197208762 / 0.15698877870055475 / 0.15686276760094522, gate 0.15.

row_level.note: frozen pool + 483 pure ThermoML Pa*s rows + 86 thawed rows

family_level.note: the frozen pool itself, reproduced in place

registered_pools.never_mixed_with: 457 epsilon scoring rows / 97 compounds / 276 (compound,T) pairs / 2029 epsilon full-table training rows: the eta channel is a SEPARATE channel and its row and compound counts are reported only against eta pools.

incumbent_reference.model_config: XGBoost n_estimators=800, max_depth=10, learning_rate=0.05, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.6, reg_lambda=1.0, seed=42; features=Morgan_count_2048+T_K+1000/T_K
incumbent_reference.note: This is a same-channel, same-protocol comparison, not a literature number. The incumbent MAE is an in-repo measured value, so the delta is meaningful.

split_protocol.identity_check: the recomputed (train_id_hash, test_id_hash) must equal the incumbent's hashes bit-for-bit, otherwise the run is void
split_protocol.random_row_split: NOT USED in this probe (row-level random CV is an in-distribution interpolation reading; it is excluded by W19-8)

chemprop_model.ffn: RegressionFFN, hidden=300, n_layers=1, input = [d_h, 2 extra molecule descriptors]
chemprop_model.descriptor_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN rows only, then applied to train and test (no test statistics leak into training)
chemprop_model.loss: MSE (chemprop default) plus chemprop MAE metric
chemprop_model.prediction_rule: primary reading = mean of the ensemble members' test predictions; per-member readings also reported

training.optimizer: chemprop default NoamLR (warmup 2 epochs, init_lr 1e-4, max_lr 1e-3, final_lr 1e-4)
training.validation_split: none (fixed epoch budget, no early stopping, no checkpoint selection) so that the test fold cannot influence any hyperparameter
training.deterministic_seed: torch.manual_seed(seed); numpy default_rng(seed) for any shuffling
training.concurrency: at most 2 training workers (two long W18 jobs are still running on this box)

metric.name: MAE
metric.evaluation_set: the grouped test fold only (838 rows / 196 keys at row_level)

gate.role: reported for context; the D5 criterion is the DELTA, not the gate

tolerance_preregistered.delta_definition: delta = MAE_chemprop - MAE_incumbent_XGB (same pool, same split, same units)
tolerance_preregistered.abs_le_0_02: consistency_confirmed -> the representation layer is not the ceiling on eta; confidence that the eta channel can cross the gate rises
tolerance_preregistered.le_minus_0_02: chemprop_better -> the representation layer is not capped on eta; open a follow-up lane
tolerance_preregistered.ge_plus_0_02: incumbent_confirmed -> the bottleneck is data / density pairing, not the representation layer

amendment_rule_declared_before_run.trigger: a timing probe (row_level, 1 member, 5 epochs) extrapolating to more than 60 minutes for the registered full run
amendment_rule_declared_before_run.allowed_reduction: reduce epochs 60 -> 30, ensemble 3 -> 1, d_h 300 -> 150, in that order, stopping as soon as the extrapolation fits the budget
amendment_rule_declared_before_run.obligation: whatever is reduced must be named in the summary and in the report
amendment_rule_declared_before_run.infeasible_path: if training is not feasible inside the budget at all, the verdict is not_obtained_feasibility with measured timing evidence, and the infeasibility is NOT dressed up as a scientific conclusion

red_lines.frozen_comparison_protocol_untouched: 457 rows / 97 compounds / 276 (compound,T) pairs / 2029 epsilon full-table training rows

expected_verdict_shape: one of consistency_confirmed / chemprop_better / incumbent_confirmed / not_obtained_feasibility
